title: Hydra Glow Serum
---

Hydra Glow Serum is Serein Studio's best-selling serum designed for daily use. Its texture is lightweight and it absorbs quickly. It helps moisturize the skin and improve skin quality. Apply every morning on a clean face. This product hydrates the skin for up to 8 hours.
